ci: run only the VM suites a change affects (#726)

* ci: run only the VM suites a change affects

Every merge group ran every hosted VM suite, the largest CI cost, even
for a documentation-only change. The planner now derives the inputs VM
suites share from Go build and test dependencies, embedded files and
the hosted image producer's inputs. A docs-only diff skips VM jobs; a
diff touching only mapped fixtures selects their suites on labelled
main PRs; anything shared or unmapped runs the full plan. Merge groups
keep the full plan behind a default-off switch and publish a shadow
selection with its estimated savings, the evidence for enabling it.

Closes #674

Release-Note: skip

* ci: keep full VM coverage when an input cannot be traced

Review found three ways a change could narrow VM coverage it should
not: a fixture or producer input symlinked into docs/, a plan run
without a base that could not see a deleted embedded file, and tests
that accepted a matrix disagreeing with its summary. The planner now
resolves VM input symlink targets in both trees, falls back to the full
suite when a reduced plan has no base, and the tests assert the emitted
package and test names.

ci.md now fixes the evidence for enabling affected selection on merge
groups: 20 full merge-group runs on main over at least three days in
which every VM failure was in a shadow-selected suite, plus the seeded
regression per narrow rule.

Release-Note: skip
